name: manual_ff0b07
claim: LINT-006 + .mcp.json args: JSON does not expand shell variables, so a literal $HOME in a JSON args array is NOT expanded by the MCP launcher. To avoid committing $HOME/... paths, use bash -c indirection: ["bash","-c","exec bash \"$HOME/path/to/wrapper.sh\""]. The outer bash -c spawns with a real shell that expands $HOME before exec-ing the target.

decisions.notes: Hit during Exa MCP wiring: .mcp.json with args:["$HOME/..."] was flagged by LINT-006 checker when expanded. Fixed with bash -c indirection. 2026-07-04.
